name: Privilege Escalation Chain
description: Principal can escalate privileges then modify/create templates

esc4.description: Ability to escalate privileges on templates

esc5.description: Ability to publish templates to CA

prerequisites: Target certificate template is NOT currently published/enabled on any Certificate Authority
Principal has privilege escalation rights (WriteOwner/WriteDacl) on unpublished template
Principal has ESC5 rights to publish templates to Certificate Authority
Certificate Authority is accessible for template publication and enrollment
steps: Use WriteOwner/WriteDacl to take control of certificate template
Grant self full permissions on the template
Modify template to create ESC1 configuration
Publish modified template to Certificate Authority
Enroll malicious certificate with privileged SAN

escalationSteps.description: Change template owner to attacker-controlled principal
Grant full control permissions to attacker
Modify template settings to enable ESC1
